## Students and Community

Students in MB 360 and LSC 170 contribute through course-based research. In 2020, 17 undergraduate volunteers participated in the Delftia WikiEDU program to improve access to information about this organism.

Explore their [projects](news.qmd) and our [learning resources](learn.qmd).

## Lab Alumni

We’d like to recognize the people who have contributed to the lab over the years. The public project materials do not yet identify former lab members by name, so we’ll add alumni profiles here as names and roles are confirmed.

## Join the Community

Students, educators, citizen scientists, and collaborators are welcome. Visit [Get Involved](about.qmd#get-involved) to learn about ways to participate.
